_comment: Measured positions of the AprilTags on the calibration wall.
x = 0 is the wall plane; the robot lives at x > 0.
y = left along the wall as seen by the robot facing it.
z = up, measured to the CENTER of the tag.
Tags face +X (out of the wall, toward the robot), which is yawDeg = 0.
Pick one tag as the origin: its y and z should be 0, and every other
tag is measured relative to it. Optional per-tag yawDeg / pitchDeg for
tags that are not flush with the wall; both default to 0.
